## 3. Connect your own server

Open the **Connect** tab in the left sidebar (labelled **Servers
** in some builds). Click **Add server**.\n\n* **HTTP**: Paste a URL ending in `/mcp`. The web app accepts **HTTPS** URLs only. Te
rminal, Desktop, and Docker accept **HTTP** or **HTTPS**; from Docker, use `host.docker.internal` for servers on your machine. Add
a bearer token or use the [OAuth Debugger](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/guided-oauth.md) if the server requires auth.\n* **S
TDIO** (Terminal, Desktop, and Docker): Paste a command such as `npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything`. In Docker the co
mmand runs inside the container. Not available in the web app. See [Hosted App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/overview.md).\n\nEa
ch **Connected** server is available in the Playground, Tools, Prompts, and Resources. Connect more from the **Connect** tab anyti

me.

> [!TIP]
>
> You should see your server show **Connected** with a green dot in the **Connect** tab, and its tools should
appear in the Playground's left rail.\n\n## 4. Where to go next", "stderr": "", "interrupted": false, "isImage": false, "noOutputE
